They are located east of the [[Western Plaguelands]] and north of the [[Hinterlands]]. The city of [[Stratholme]], located on the Eastern Plaguelands' northern edge, played an important role for the Scourge during the [[Third War]]: It was there that [[Arthas Menethil|Prince Arthas]] of Lordaeron enacted the [[Culling of Stratholme]], marking a point of no return in his fall to darkness. After the war, the Eastern Plaguelands became the center of Scourge power in Lordaeron, with Stratholme acting as their southern capital under the rule of the lich [[Kel'Thuzad]]. The area is roamed by mutant creatures and soldiers of the [[Scourge]], while members of the [[Scarlet Crusade]] fight a constant battle to drive the Scourge out of [[Stratholme]] from their Chapel and key base at [[Tyr's Hand]]. Only a small camp maintained by the [[Argent Dawn]] remains friendly to all, welcoming adventurers that would lend a strong arm or spell. Located at [[Light's Hope Chapel]], this staging area serves as a last bastion of Light in a land blanketed in darkness. ==Geography== The Eastern Plaguelands contain a normal instanced dungeon, [[Stratholme]], as well as the raid dungeon [[Naxxramas]]. The micro dungeon [[Tyr's Hand]] can also be found here. [[Light's Hope Chapel]] serves as a travel hub for both the Horde and the Alliance. There are no battlegrounds in this zone, though it is a world PvP area. === Maps and subregions === [[File:WorldMap-EasternPlaguelands.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of the Eastern Plaguelands]] WorldMap-EasternPlaguelands-old2.jpg|The Eastern Plaguelands prior to [[patch 1.17.1]].
